mechanism: Torsemide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities may reduce atovaquone absorption and efficacy, while loop diuretics increase risk of ototoxicity and renal impairment in combination with potentially nephrotoxic antimicrobials.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and atovaquone efficacy; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic if possible; assess hearing function with concurrent use.
